editorial.description: Nekajui Peninsula Papagayo is a five-star Ritz-Carlton Reserve set within a 567-hectare private peninsula on Costa Rica's Pacific coast. Surrounded by protected forest and turquoise waters above Playa Pochote, it blends refined dining, a Nicoyan-inspired spa, and treetop luxury accommodations.

faq.q: Where is Nekajui Peninsula Papagayo located?
faq.a: Nekajui is located at the end of National Route 253 on Peninsula Papagayo in Nacascolo, Liberia, Guanacaste, on Costa Rica's Pacific coast.

faq.q: How do I get to the resort from the airport?
faq.a: The nearest airport is Daniel Oduber Quiros International in Liberia (LIR), about 35 km away. The hotel does not offer its own shuttle, but alternative airport transport can be arranged with advance reservation.
